meta.title: Trek of Discovery - 4
meta.description: As we ascend, the light shines burning, the path we sought now wholly illuminated.

units.rawText: Whew, this should be the last place... Antonina, should I run the Overwrite Program immediately?
units.displayText: Whew, this should be the last place... Antonina, should I run the Overwrite Program immediately?

spans.text: Whew, this should be the last place... Antonina, should I run the Overwrite Program immediately?

units.rawText: No, this time, just plant the Overwrite Program... I mean, the sword in the ground. We'll take it from there.
units.displayText: No, this time, just plant the Overwrite Program... I mean, the sword in the ground. We'll take it from there.

spans.text: No, this time, just plant the Overwrite Program... I mean, the sword in the ground. We'll take it from there.

units.rawText: Got it.
units.displayText: Got it.

spans.text: Got it.

units.rawText: Persicaria plants the sword into the ground. There is a violent shaking, and the archaic sword begins glowing with blinding light.
units.displayText: Persicaria plants the sword into the ground. There is a violent shaking, and the archaic sword begins glowing with blinding light.

spans.text: Persicaria plants the sword into the ground. There is a violent shaking, and the archaic sword begins glowing with blinding light.

units.rawText: The Overwrite Program is working. Now shutting down regional defense programs and rewriting code...
units.displayText: The Overwrite Program is working. Now shutting down regional defense programs and rewriting code...

spans.text: The Overwrite Program is working. Now shutting down regional defense programs and rewriting code...

units.rawText: Whew...
units.displayText: Whew...

spans.text: Whew...

units.rawText: Persicaria breathes a sigh of relief as the surrounding environment finally stabilizes.
units.displayText: Persicaria breathes a sigh of relief as the surrounding environment finally stabilizes.

spans.text: Persicaria breathes a sigh of relief as the surrounding environment finally stabilizes.

units.rawText: Alright. Now, while the installer is still running, may I ask WHY you put yourself in such danger?
units.displayText: Alright. Now, while the installer is still running, may I ask WHY you put yourself in such danger?

spans.text: Alright. Now, while the installer is still running, may I ask WHY you put yourself in such danger?

units.rawText: You forced compatibility with the Overwrite Program, charged in like a lunatic and got yourself hurt all over!
units.displayText: You forced compatibility with the Overwrite Program, charged in like a lunatic and got yourself hurt all over!

spans.text: You forced compatibility with the Overwrite Program, charged in like a lunatic and got yourself hurt all over!

units.rawText: Uh... Ah, I, er...
units.displayText: Uh... Ah, I, er...

spans.text: Uh... Ah, I, er...

units.rawText: Persicaria wrings her hand in embarrassment and then puts them together in supplication.
units.displayText: Persicaria wrings her hand in embarrassment and then puts them together in supplication.

spans.text: Persicaria wrings her hand in embarrassment and then puts them together in supplication.

units.rawText: I'm sorry!
units.displayText: I'm sorry!

spans.text: I'm sorry!

units.rawText: (Sigh) Honestly... Every single one of you... How are any of you different from those pesky clients, anyway?!
units.displayText: (Sigh) Honestly... Every single one of you... How are any of you different from those pesky clients, anyway?!

spans.text: (Sigh) Honestly... Every single one of you... How are any of you different from those pesky clients, anyway?!

units.rawText: Let me get this out of the way right now; you'd better double the current budget for the Technical Department after this!
units.displayText: Let me get this out of the way right now; you'd better double the current budget for the Technical Department after this!

spans.text: Let me get this out of the way right now; you'd better double the current budget for the Technical Department after this!

units.rawText: However, the expected lecture does not come. Instead, the longsword form of the Overwrite Program begins glowing with golden light.
units.displayText: However, the expected lecture does not come. Instead, the longsword form of the Overwrite Program begins glowing with golden light.

spans.text: However, the expected lecture does not come. Instead, the longsword form of the Overwrite Program begins glowing with golden light.

units.rawText: Huh? Antonina?
units.displayText: Huh? Antonina?

spans.text: Huh? Antonina?

units.rawText: Persicaria, put your hand on the sword.
units.displayText: Persicaria, put your hand on the sword.

spans.text: Persicaria, put your hand on the sword.

units.rawText: Like this?
units.displayText: Like this?

spans.text: Like this?

units.rawText: The golden light flows from the Overwrite Program into Persicaria's body.
units.displayText: The golden light flows from the Overwrite Program into Persicaria's body.

spans.text: The golden light flows from the Overwrite Program into Persicaria's body.

units.rawText: Wait... This is...
units.displayText: Wait... This is...

spans.text: Wait... This is...

units.rawText: I told you, right? No matter how crazy your plans are, I'll always help you find the most effective way to realize them.
units.displayText: I told you, right? No matter how crazy your plans are, I'll always help you find the most effective way to realize them.

spans.text: I told you, right? No matter how crazy your plans are, I'll always help you find the most effective way to realize them.

units.rawText: The operand supply within the Overwrite Program, the combat experience inside the fragment... and your will... That's my gift to you.
units.displayText: The operand supply within the Overwrite Program, the combat experience inside the fragment... and your will... That's my gift to you.

spans.text: The operand supply within the Overwrite Program, the combat experience inside the fragment... and your will... That's my gift to you.

units.rawText: Get ready for it, Persicaria.
units.displayText: Get ready for it, Persicaria.

spans.text: Get ready for it, Persicaria.

units.rawText: Persicaria closes her eyes and allows Antonina's program to enter her.
units.displayText: Persicaria closes her eyes and allows Antonina's program to enter her.

spans.text: Persicaria closes her eyes and allows Antonina's program to enter her.

units.rawText: <color=orange>CQB Module, neural connection confirmed...</color>
units.displayText: CQB Module, neural connection confirmed...

spans.text: CQB Module, neural connection confirmed...

units.rawText: <color=orange>Combat operand module allocation adjusted, neural projection improved. Experimental operand prefab device Mk 2 improvements complete...</color>
units.displayText: Combat operand module allocation adjusted, neural projection improved. Experimental operand prefab device Mk 2 improvements complete...

spans.text: Combat operand module allocation adjusted, neural projection improved. Experimental operand prefab device Mk 2 improvements complete...

units.rawText: <color=orange>Weapon cluster altered...</color>
units.displayText: Weapon cluster altered...

spans.text: Weapon cluster altered...

units.rawText: Persicaria opens her eyes again. The fatigue there is gone, replaced by a keener, sharper expression.
units.displayText: Persicaria opens her eyes again. The fatigue there is gone, replaced by a keener, sharper expression.

spans.text: Persicaria opens her eyes again. The fatigue there is gone, replaced by a keener, sharper expression.

units.rawText: You even improved my projection... Antonina, this is...
units.displayText: You even improved my projection... Antonina, this is...

spans.text: You even improved my projection... Antonina, this is...

units.rawText: We can't have you meeting the Professor looking like you just woke up, can we?
units.displayText: We can't have you meeting the Professor looking like you just woke up, can we?

spans.text: We can't have you meeting the Professor looking like you just woke up, can we?

units.rawText: Haha, that's true.
units.displayText: Haha, that's true.

spans.text: Haha, that's true.

units.rawText: Persicaria's cheeks flush pink and she looks at her brand new gear.
units.displayText: Persicaria's cheeks flush pink and she looks at her brand new gear.

spans.text: Persicaria's cheeks flush pink and she looks at her brand new gear.

units.rawText: Thank you, Antonina.
units.displayText: Thank you, Antonina.

spans.text: Thank you, Antonina.

units.rawText: This way, I won't have to worry about you going crazy out there. Now go, Persicaria!
units.displayText: This way, I won't have to worry about you going crazy out there. Now go, Persicaria!

spans.text: This way, I won't have to worry about you going crazy out there. Now go, Persicaria!

units.rawText: Yup!
units.displayText: Yup!

spans.text: Yup!

units.rawText: (Professor, this time, I won't stand behind you... This time... I want to stand beside you and see what you see!)
units.displayText: Professor, this time, I won't stand behind you... This time... I want to stand beside you and see what you see!

spans.text: Professor, this time, I won't stand behind you... This time... I want to stand beside you and see what you see!

units.rawText: Persicaria takes up the longsword and holds it up high.
units.displayText: Persicaria takes up the longsword and holds it up high.

spans.text: Persicaria takes up the longsword and holds it up high.

units.rawText: <color=orange><size=40>Module: Persicaria, Progrise Key Confirmed... Commence upgrade!</size></color>
units.displayText: Module: Persicaria, Progrise Key Confirmed... Commence upgrade!

spans.text: Module: Persicaria, Progrise Key Confirmed... Commence upgrade!
